title: Clinical profile and genomic characterization of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus index case in Uganda
snippet: The case was identified following the clinical deterioration and death of an adult male patient from the DRC who was admitted to a private hospital in Kampala, Uganda, in May 2026. Demographic information, including patient sex and travel history from the DRC, was extracted from a standardized national VHF case investigation form and the electronic case admission record. Given the clinical course, an incomplete epidemiological history and regional concern for VHF, a posthumous EDTA whole-blood [...] no blood work was performed before he left, and then self-referred to a private hospital in Kampala. On admission on 11 May 2026, the patient presented with severe vomiting, frequent diarrhea, intermittent epigastric pain, generalized weakness and hiccups; vomiting and diarrhea had reportedly persisted for more than 2 weeks, although the exact symptom onset date was not ascertained. Initial assessment documented marked weakness, epigastric tenderness, bilateral chest crackles, borderline [...] Bundibugyo virus disease remains a high-consequence threat in Eastern and Central Africa, where cross-border mobility, nonspecific early symptoms and delayed recognition can obscure transmission.
